stdout_size_estimates.basis: Exact logs were not persisted; estimates are based on observed command output, 497 verbose unittest lines, smoke summaries, and install-smoke build output truncation.

validation_results.summary: Clean working tree on correction/aso-stage1-defect-remediation-v3.8.0 before evidence edits.
Failed before package mutation because the system Python is PEP 668 externally managed.
Initial run found ignored Python bytecode cache artifacts; cache cleanup was performed and the guard then passed.
Clean source install, installed CLI smoke, wheel install smoke, and sdist install smoke passed from temporary directories.
Source hygiene passed; 497 ASO tests passed in 289.560s; 6 top-level tests passed in 0.600s.
Package status, lint, doctor, package-layout, design/context/rules/state/plan/dashboard/checkpoint/governance smoke passed; SMOKE_RESULT: passed (18 assertions).
ASO doctor passed with 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 info, and 0 findings.

evidence: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 agent-system/tools/aso/aso.py lifecycle --help lists receive-result and terminate-agent only.
defect_reproduction_matrix.finding: PROJECT_COMPLETED, FINAL_CHECKPOINT_COMPLETE, NO_NEXT_ACTION, and lifecycle finalize are not available in the baseline.

evidence: Read-only source inventory found routing/action literals in multiple command modules including plan_next.py, record_result.py, checkpoint_preflight.py, status.py, dashboard.py, and orchestrator.py.
agent-system/tools/aso/tests/test_transition_engine.py covers a central transition engine but does not prove all commands are thin wrappers over it.
defect_reproduction_matrix.finding: The baseline still needs the Task 030 authority pass before declaring the transition engine the only operational route source.
The stale sidecar mode is reproducible and guarded, but NEXT_ACTION is not yet a derived/cache view.
Manual append-only lifecycle events can diverge from materialized sidecars; structured receive-result mitigates only the confirmed command path.
Profile pass routing still requires accepted result-package bookkeeping; separate result-only lifecycle mode is not present.
The baseline already records governed audit result receipts for the tested failed-audit lifecycle path.
The current command paths have shared parser coverage for RESULT and AUDIT_RESULT parsing.
Canonical manifest.json plus legacy artifact_package_manifest.json alias behavior is present in the baseline.
Failed audit routes to CORRECTION_REQUIRED and blocks checkpoint in the current tested paths.

evidence: Read-only rg for correction_of, resolved_by, effective_status found no active implementation references.
agent-system/tools/aso/tests does not contain test_correction_resolution_graph.py in the baseline.
defect_reproduction_matrix.finding: The effective correction-resolution graph is not implemented; only superseded_by appears in existing artifact/state metadata.

evidence: Read-only rg for SB0, SB1, SB2, SB3, and SB4 found no active severity-tier implementation.
agent-system/tools/aso/tests/test_context_pack_build.py and test_validate_context_pack.py cover forbidden/bounded context but not SB0-SB4 tiers.
defect_reproduction_matrix.finding: The baseline has coarse source/context guards but no severity-tier model.
Routine context minimization and broad-corpus rejection are already covered in the baseline.

evidence: No live invalid worker-output corpus was available in the task environment.
agent-system/tools/aso/tests has parser and schema fixtures, but the future focused test_role_output_contracts.py is absent from the baseline.
defect_reproduction_matrix.finding: Schema-invalid real role outputs cannot be reproduced without captured agent outputs; existing malformed fixtures do not prove the real role-output defect.
Manual sidecar/log drift remains reproducible; structured render/materialization exists but does not remove the drift class.

evidence: Read-only focused-test inventory found no test_operator_reporting.py in agent-system/tools/aso/tests.
Existing release reports under agent-system/11_release are manual evidence files.
defect_reproduction_matrix.finding: Operator report/final run receipt generation is not automated in the baseline.
